note: The ongoing library beyond the ninety-day challenge. Selected from 98 researched candidates against one test: a working developer has not seen it, and wants it on sight. Weighted toward universal browser support, because these get pasted into client pages.

components.name: Weight Shift Button
components.summary: Hold it and the label physically thickens and widens on the font's weight and width axes, then springs past rest before settling. Zero JavaScript.
components.blocked: Needs a variable font carrying both the wght and wdth axes. Bricolage is subset to weights 700-800 only, and adding a second variable font costs payload the site was explicitly trimmed to avoid. Revisit by subsetting one face to the two axes and a small glyph set.

components.name: Constraint Solver Form
components.summary: Interdependent dimensions where you mark which fields drive and which derive. Over-constrain it and it names the exact field to relax, rather than saying invalid.

components.name: Snap Guide Canvas
components.summary: Drag a block and guides snap it to the edges, centres and equal-spacing rhythm of its neighbours, with live distance badges. The alignment engine, not the canvas.

components.name: Tear-Off Panel
components.summary: Drag a panel off its dock and it becomes a real second browser window, still live and in sync through a BroadcastChannel. Drag it back to redock.

components.name: Country Address Form
components.summary: Switch the country and the form rebuilds — fields reorder, labels rewrite, the state select disappears, Japan grows a furigana row. Not every name is first and last.

components.name: Origin Morph Dialog
components.summary: Grows out of the exact row that opened it, which becomes its header, and stays tethered to it. View Transitions and anchor positioning, both Baseline in 2026.

components.name: Multiscript Text Column
components.summary: Breaks Thai without spaces, honours Japanese kinsoku, and keeps Arabic letters joined at narrow measures. A ruler shows every legal break opportunity.

components.name: Magic Plus Drag
components.summary: The plus is not clicked — it is torn off and dropped between two rows, and the item is created exactly there, the list parting to show where it will land.

components.name: Paste Drop Inspector
components.summary: Fans out every flavour the clipboard actually handed you, with byte sizes, and unfolds a dropped directory as a tree. Most apps read text/plain and discard the rest.

components.name: Pressure Signature Pad
components.summary: Stroke width swells and tapers with real stylus pressure and tilt, drawn from the coalesced samples between frames that a mouse-event version throws away.

components.name: Grapheme Budget Field
components.summary: Counts what a person would call a character. A family emoji costs one, not eleven, and truncation never splits a cluster into tofu.

components.name: Adjust Last Action
components.summary: After an action completes, a panel shows that action's parameters. Change one and it silently re-runs from the pre-action state — retroactive tuning, not undo and retry.

components.name: Priority Overflow Toolbar
components.summary: Measures its own content rather than the viewport, so at 400 percent zoom the actions migrate into the overflow menu one by one instead of clipping away.

components.name: Fold Reveal Section
components.summary: Unfolds like a paper map as you scroll, panels rotating open on shared hinges, each catching a different amount of light.

components.name: Bertin Matrix
components.summary: The data does not move — the rows and columns do. Reordering both axes drags structure onto the diagonal that no single-column sort reveals.

components.name: Safe Triangle Hover
components.summary: Draws the wedge your pointer is allowed to travel through on its way to the panel, so moving diagonally never dismisses it. Taps to toggle on coarse pointers.

components.name: Bidi Comment Card
components.summary: Arabic and Hebrew text mixed with Latin handles, URLs and trailing punctuation, isolated per string so the period stops teleporting to the wrong end of the line.

components.name: Zone Overlap Ribbon
components.summary: Working-hours bands across timezones, where one participant's band visibly jogs an hour mid-week at the daylight-saving seam and Kathmandu sits off the gridlines.

components.name: Shared Field Steps
components.summary: Between wizard steps the fields that persist glide to their new positions while only the new ones fade in. The form reorganises instead of sliding panels.

components.name: Infinite Drag Field
components.summary: Drag the label and the number climbs forever — the cursor vanishes, wraps at the screen edge, and never runs out of travel. Modifiers change the precision.

components.name: Localized Progress Loader
components.summary: The sentence rewrites itself as the count changes, through the live plural category, and the bar fills from the inline start so it runs the other way in Arabic.

components.name: Challenge Response Checklist
components.summary: Each item states a condition to verify and is confirmed individually, with one deliberate hold. Aviation discipline instead of typing the repo name.

components.name: Scroll Condense Wordmark
components.summary: Compresses on the font's width axis as the page scrolls — narrowing rather than shrinking — to slot into the collapsed bar.

components.name: Switch Scanning Menu
components.summary: A bar of light walks the groups; one key drops inside and walks the items, with a countdown ring for the dwell. How single-switch users actually navigate.

components.name: Collation Sort Table
components.summary: The same ten names take four different orders depending on locale. Ö belongs in the middle in German and at the end in Swedish, and neither is UTF-16 order.
